title: Client Pitch Deck Document
description: Stage 3 of the Velvet Oat pipeline: the client-facing pitch deck for Aurora Dairy's board (route-selection meeting, 2026-07-10). Sells the recommended route persuasively, maps the EUR 120k investment, timeline and expected outcomes. Per the metamorphosis contract, the full hop-1 creative brief is carried verbatim under 'brief' and the full hop-2 concept deck (all three routes, recommendation and rationale) under 'concepts' / 'recommended_route'. Nothing from prior stages may be dropped.

executive_summary.description: Board-level summary of the opportunity, the recommendation and the ask, in confident client-facing language.

pitch_narrative.description: The strategic story: insight, proposition, idea, and how the campaign comes to life.

recommended_route.description: The route being sold to the board, including hybridisation of supporting routes.

alternatives_considered.description: Routes B and C, kept visible for the board.

timeline.description: Milestones from route selection to in-market launch.

expected_outcomes.description: KPIs the campaign is accountable to, traced to the brief's success metrics.

brief.description: The complete stage-1 creative brief, carried verbatim from hop 1 (account planner). Must not be dropped.

concepts.description: The complete stage-2 concept deck routes, carried verbatim from hop 2 (creative director). Must not be dropped.

recommended_concept.description: Carried from hop 2: concept_name of the recommended route.

recommendation_rationale.description: Carried from hop 2: the creative director's reasoning.
